page.overview:
Who is Arngrim?

Arngrim is an optional playable character and summonable vision in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. He serves as a character representative from the Valkyrie Profile series, more specifically his incarnation from the game Valkyrie Profile -Lenneth-.

In the original game, Arngrim is the first Einherjar to join Lenneth and the only one who cannot be send to Valhalla, unable to join Odin's army after death.

Arngrim is a limited-time 5-7★ Rare Summon, who was available during the collaboration with Valkyrie Profile, the raid event Lost City of Dipan (which originally ran in October 2018 in the Global version). His job is listed as Mercenary, and his role is Physical Damage. He has no innate element or status ailment resistances. His Trust Master reward is...
